market_notes: Spanish serves travellers from Spain and Latin America, so vocabulary splits between carnet de conducir (Spain) and licencia de conducir (Latin America), moto and scooter. Searches lean on practical worries — travel insurance with motorbike exclusions, passports left as deposit, the international permit — and on the Ha Giang Loop.

proposals.working_title: Cómo conducir una moto semiautomática: marchas sin embrague
proposals.intent_rationale: Visitors who have only ridden automatic scooters search for how to operate a clutchless semi-automatic before choosing one; how-to intent, distinct from the manual-versus-automatic choice guide.

proposals.working_title: 110, 125 o 150 cc: qué cilindrada elegir para ciudad y montaña
proposals.intent_rationale: Riders planning mountain routes compare engine capacity and ask what their licence class permits; complements the 50cc/electric guide, which covers the low-power end.

proposals.primary_query: honda wave o honda vision alquiler
secondary_queries: qué moto alquilar en vietnam principiante
proposals.working_title: Honda Wave, Vision y Air Blade: tipos de moto de alquiler explicados
proposals.intent_rationale: Model names are how many renters actually search. Explaining the widely sold Honda families as vehicle types, with no availability claim, captures comparison intent the generic Hub cannot.

proposals.primary_query: moto para dos personas con equipaje vietnam
secondary_queries: ir de paquete en moto vietnam
proposals.working_title: Dos personas y equipaje: cómo elegir el vehículo adecuado
proposals.intent_rationale: Couples and backpackers ask whether one bike can carry two people and luggage safely; a decision guide about load, seating and handling that no existing row answers.

proposals.working_title: Alquiler de larga duración en Hanói para expatriados y estudiantes
proposals.intent_rationale: Residents, students and long-stay workers rent for months and need maintenance, paperwork and contract answers that a day/week/month price comparison does not cover.

secondary_queries: se quedan el pasaporte alquiler moto
proposals.working_title: Dejar el pasaporte como depósito: riesgos y alternativas
proposals.intent_rationale: Leaving an identity document as security is a recurring traveller worry that official travel advice addresses; covers risks and questions to ask, never a provider's policy.

proposals.working_title: Más allá del precio: gasolina, aparcamiento, entrega y daños
proposals.intent_rationale: People comparing quotes want to know which charges sit outside the rental fee; scoped to cost categories and questions to ask, never to amounts.
First-time riders ask which petrol grade to buy and how stations work; practical, low-risk content that supports cost and breakdown-prevention questions.

proposals.working_title: Permiso internacional de conducir y motos en Vietnam
proposals.intent_rationale: Licence validity is the highest-stakes rental question. This guide is scoped to the international permit itself, separate from the home-licence guide, and must follow current official sources.

proposals.primary_query: moto alquilada robada vietnam quién paga
proposals.working_title: Daños y robo: la responsabilidad en el contrato de alquiler
proposals.intent_rationale: Disputes over scratches, damage and theft are a major source of rental conflict; explains clauses to read and evidence to keep, without legal promises.
proposals.research_gap: Civil-law liability sources are not attached; drafting must cite the governing civil-code provisions or stay at questions-to-ask level.

secondary_queries: seguro de viaje sin carnet de moto
proposals.working_title: ¿Cubre el seguro de viaje un accidente de moto en Vietnam?
proposals.intent_rationale: Riders want to know what compulsory liability insurance covers and whether travel insurance pays after a crash; needs current decree references (67/2023 as amended by 220/2026) and policy-specific caveats.

proposals.primary_query: tarjeta de registro moto vietnam blue card
secondary_queries: documentos para conducir moto en vietnam
proposals.working_title: Qué papeles llevar al conducir: la tarjeta de registro y más
proposals.intent_rationale: Riders ask which papers to carry if stopped, notably the vehicle registration card ('blue card'); distinct from the rental-documents Hub, which covers renting rather than riding.

proposals.working_title: Casco en Vietnam: normas, talla y llevar el tuyo
proposals.intent_rationale: Helmets are mandatory and the single biggest injury-prevention factor; readers ask about standards, fit and whether to bring their own.

proposals.primary_query: conducir moto en hanói tráfico consejos
proposals.working_title: Conducir en el tráfico de Hanói: cómo funciona el flujo
proposals.intent_rationale: First-time riders need to understand Hanoi's traffic flow and core rules before riding; distinct from the rain and breakdown guides and from the general safety Hub.

secondary_queries: hanói zona de bajas emisiones motos
proposals.working_title: Zona de bajas emisiones del Anillo 1 de Hanói: qué cambia para quien alquila moto
proposals.intent_rationale: Hanoi announced a phased low-emission zone for Ring Road 1 starting with a 2026 pilot; renters need a sourced, date-checked explainer that does not overstate what is restricted.

proposals.working_title: Control de policía con moto alquilada: qué esperar
proposals.intent_rationale: Travellers worry about traffic police checks; covers documents to carry and the expected procedure, with no invented fine amounts.

proposals.primary_query: accidente de moto en vietnam qué hacer
proposals.working_title: Después de un accidente de moto en Vietnam: primeros pasos
proposals.intent_rationale: After a collision readers need immediate first steps and emergency contacts; distinct from the breakdown guide, which covers mechanical failure.
